exposure: dose of hyperbaric Ropivacaine administered via subarachnoid block (10mg, 5mg, 4mg, and 3mg)
outcome: anesthetic efficacy (onset time for block initiation, recovery duration, requirement for additional anesthetics, satisfaction rate regarding abdominal wall muscle relaxation)
safety profiles (incidence of adverse reactions, utilization rate of vasopressors)
cohort: 74 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section at Nantong Maternal and Child Health Care Hospital.
finding: Administering 4 mg hyperbaric Ropivacaine via subarachnoid block for cesarean section provides optimal anesthesia with a high safety level, mild abdominal wall muscle relaxation, and reduced stress and inflammatory responses.
